question.text: In Bohr series of lines of hydrogen spectrum, the third line from the red end corresponds to which one of the following inter-orbit jumps of the electron for Bohr orbits in an atom of hydrogen

solution.text: The lines falling in the visible region comprise Balmer series. Hence the third line would be $n_1=2, n_2=5$ i.e. $5 \rightarrow 2$
